description: Evaluate a bounded custom market-risk return series as a linear combination of MKT, SMB, HML, MOM, RMW, and rf from the RQ runtime store. This is attribution research, not a strategy expression runtime.
code:
function origin(){return(process.env.ALPHALAB_API_ORIGIN||'http://127.0.0.1:8000').replace(/\/+$/,'')}
async function run(input){const body={name:String(input.name||'').trim(),expression:String(input.expression||'').trim(),profile:'runtime'};if(input.start_date)body.start_date=String(input.start_date);if(input.end_date)body.end_date=String(input.end_date);const response=await fetch(origin()+'/api/market/custom-risk-factor/evaluate',{method:'POST',headers:{Accept:'application/json','Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('AlphaLab API '+response.status+': '+await response.text());return response.json()}
